name: Hero's Journey (12 stages)
source: Joseph Campbell via Christopher Vogler, The Writer's Journey
license_note: Public-domain mythic structure; prompts are original prose.

beats.name: Ordinary World
beats.prompt: What does normal look like, and what is missing from it?

beats.name: Call to Adventure
beats.prompt: What summons disturbs the ordinary world?

beats.name: Refusal of the Call
beats.prompt: Why does the hero hesitate — what fear speaks?

beats.name: Meeting the Mentor
beats.prompt: Who or what equips the hero to cross over?

beats.name: Crossing the Threshold
beats.prompt: What marks the point of no return into the special world?

beats.name: Tests, Allies, Enemies
beats.prompt: How does the special world teach its rules?

beats.name: Approach to the Inmost Cave
beats.prompt: What preparations precede the central ordeal?

beats.name: Ordeal
beats.prompt: What death-and-rebirth does the hero face at the core?

beats.name: Reward (Seizing the Sword)
beats.prompt: What is won, and at what hidden cost?

beats.name: The Road Back
beats.prompt: What pursuit or consequence drives the return?

beats.name: Resurrection
beats.prompt: What final test proves the change is real?

beats.name: Return with the Elixir
beats.prompt: What boon does the hero bring back to the ordinary world?
